name: CRICKET VR
summary:
Experience Cricket Like Never Before – In Virtual Reality!

Step onto the pitch, hear the crowd roar, and enjoy an immersive VR cricket experience built for true fans. Whether you're setting a huge total or chasing a challenging target, every shot feels authentic with realistic batting physics and immersive controller haptics.

🏏 Features

Realistic VR batting with precise physics and satisfying haptic feedback.
Dynamic AI bowlers featuring right- and left-arm pace, yorkers, bouncers, swing, and spin deliv
